correctness.rationale: An independent exact reimplementation of the displayed \(6\times25\) matrix over \(\mathbb F_3\) verified rank six, 25 distinct normalized projective columns, the stated complete 729-codeword weight distribution with minimum weight 11, and absence of every strict support containment among the 364 projective nonzero codewords. It also checked all 364 projective hyperplanes and found rank five for every intersection, and directly verified the translated trifference condition for all 264628 unordered pairs of distinct nonzero messages. Thus the strong-blocking, minimal-code, trifferent, and weight claims are exhaustive finite facts rather than sampled evidence. The concatenation rate \(6/25\cdot23/78=23/325\) is exact arithmetic.
risks: The theorem certifies only this concrete matrix; it does not prove optimality at length 25 or settle existence of a valid length-24 witness.
